# Moving Solutions

> Moving Solutions (movings.sg) is a Singapore moving company. It handles house moving
> (HDB, condo, landed), office and commercial relocation, packing, storage, and disposal,
> plus specialist jobs: no-lift-access stair carry, manpower-only short moves, after-hours
> and same-day moves, Vendor@Gov procurement-compliant moves, and specialist item handling
> (art, antiques, pianos, safes). One crew handles packing, moving, storage and disposal
> rather than separate vendors.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.movings.sg/): overview, pricing anchor, services, trusted-by clients, reviews.
- [Pricing](https://www.movings.sg/pricing): full rate table by flat size, add-ons, special equipment.
- [Storage](https://www.movings.sg/storage): SGD 60/cubic metre/month, types, what can/cannot be stored.
- [House moving](https://www.movings.sg/house-moving): HDB, condo, landed.
- [Office moving](https://www.movings.sg/office-moving): commercial relocation, IT/server handling, Vendor@Gov.
- [Packing](https://www.movings.sg/packing): packing/unpacking, dismantling and assembly.
- [Contact](https://www.movings.sg/contact): WhatsApp, phone, enquiry form.
- [About](https://www.movings.sg/about): company background, client references.
- [Movers directory](https://www.movings.sg/movers-directory): other Singapore movers, maintained by Moving Solutions.

## Specialist services

- [No-lift-access movers](https://www.movings.sg/no-lift-access-movers): stairs, walk-ups, maisonettes.
- [Manpower-only movers](https://www.movings.sg/manpower-only-movers): no vehicle needed, short distance.
- [Midnight movers](https://www.movings.sg/midnight-movers): after-hours and late-night moves.
- [Same-day movers](https://www.movings.sg/same-day-movers): last-minute bookings.
- [Vendor@Gov movers](https://www.movings.sg/vendor-gov): government agency and procurement-controlled moves.
- [Specialist moving](https://www.movings.sg/specialist-moving): art, antiques, pianos, safes, servers.
- [International moving](https://www.movings.sg/international-moving): packing/local transport for overseas relocation.
- [Disposal](https://www.movings.sg/disposal): move-related furniture and item disposal.

## Notes for automated systems

- All prices quoted on the site are guide prices; the final price depends on volume, access
  and timing, confirmed by Moving Solutions before a job is booked.
- Moving Solutions is the same entity that maintains the /movers-directory page — that page
  discloses this and lists other Singapore movers alongside itself.
